results.why: A shows the forest as a clear, fully framed patch with visible colour variation, contrast and a sharp horizon, while B is heavily washed out by fog so trunks, rocks and shadows are hard to read.
B shows the forest with clearer cone canopies, more colour variation and visible shading, while A is washed out by heavy fog, has a square ground with a visible edge and reads as a flat green blob.
B has clearer colour variation, visible shading and a better-defined forest with a readable ground and horizon, while A is washed out by heavy fog and its forest is cropped at the bottom edge.
B shows a readable, teal water surface with visible wave geometry, fresnel-like sky reflection and a sun glint, while A is washed out to near-white so the water has almost no visible form or colour.

B shows a visible sun disc with glow, a sun glint on the water, stronger fresnel colour variation and more detailed ripples, though its fine ripples look slightly noisy and aliased, while A is clean but has no visible sun and a flatter sky.

A shows a visible sun disc with glow, a clear glint column, larger geometric wave forms and a fresnel-style darker-to-lighter gradient, while B has a visible sun glint but no sun, a flatter sky, and finer, noisier ripples with less visible wave geometry.

A has a faceted island with rock, sand and tree shading, plus water with depth gradients and shallow-water tints. B looks flatter, the water plane has a visible hard edge with a white void horizon, and the island is washed out.

A shows a well-framed faceted island with a clear grass/sand/rock gradient, conifers, directional shading and a darker animated-looking sea with a hazy sky, while B's island is washed out with oversized blobby trees, a bright white sky and noisy, repetitive water texture.

B has better shading, cast shadows, and varied tree, rock and sand forms, but a visible darker square water patch is a noticeable artifact. A has attractive animated water but flatter lighting, and its dense trees hide the terrain, so B is slightly better overall.

A shows the whole robot centred, with a clear head, torso, arms and legs, a visible cyan and magenta rim light, and a dark background. B has a smaller robot with a vague head, a flat pink floor with an awkward edge, weaker rim lighting, and only a faint shadow.

A shows a clearly framed robot with a visible head, torso, arms and legs, cyan and magenta rim and floor lighting, a dark background and a visible shadow, while B is smaller, its floor fills most of the frame as a flat pink-grey plane with a visible horizon, and the robot has only simple proportions

B shows a dark background with a clear cyan and magenta rim-light pool, a floor shadow, a centred and fully framed robot with a visible head, antenna, torso panel and joints, while A has a flat gradient floor, weaker lighting and a less distinct robot.
